title: Desk bridge v0: cmd
description: The command registry, kept by the core. Clicks, keys, the palette, Eris, agents and the CLI all invoke commands through it, and the desk's built-in commands are registered in it like any other (ADR 0017). Callers register, unregister and answer their own commands without a scope; listing and invoking need cmd:invoke. Commands marked agent are offered to agents as tools (cmd.tools, ADR 0084). Commands that name an `undo` land on the desk's undo stack, which cmd.undo and cmd.redo walk (ADR 0077).

CommandInfo.description: A registered command as cmd.list returns it.

title.description: Shown in the palette and menus.

description.description: One or two sentences for people.

argsSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for the args of cmd.invoke; absent means the command takes none.

when.description: A context expression the runtime evaluates to offer the command; absent means always.

undo.description: The command that undoes this one: cmd.undo runs it with { args, result } of an invocation. Absent when the command cannot be undone.

resultSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) of what the command answers; absent when it is not described. The core does not check answers.

agent.description: Agents are offered the command as a tool (cmd.tools, ADR 0084). Absent means false.

readOnly.description: The command only reads: it answers data and changes nothing the person keeps. Absent means false.

irreversible.description: The provider's manifest marks the command irreversible: an agent's call waits for the person's approval (ADR 0078). Absent means false.

CmdRegisterRequest.description: Register one of the caller's commands, or update it.

CmdRegisterParams.description: Parameters of cmd.register. The caller becomes the command's provider.

description.description: What the command does and answers, for people and agents. Absent: the manifest's, if any.

argsSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for the args of cmd.invoke. Absent: the manifest's (args), if any.

when.description: A context expression, as keybindings use; absent means always available.

undo.description: The command that undoes this one, which the caller provides too. Absent: the one the caller's manifest names for this id in contributes.commands, if any.

resultSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) of what the command answers. Absent: the one the caller's manifest names for this id (result), if any.

agent.description: Offer the command to agents as a tool (ADR 0084); it needs a description, here or in the manifest. Absent: the manifest's, else false.

readOnly.description: The command only reads: it answers data and changes nothing the person keeps. Absent: the manifest's, else false. A command the manifest marks irreversible is never read-only.

CmdUnregisterRequest.description: Remove one of the caller's commands.

CmdListRequest.description: List the registered commands the scope covers.

CmdListResult.description: Result of cmd.list, in registration order.

CmdInvokeRequest.description: Invoke a command, whoever provides it. The core records the caller.

CmdInvokeParams.description: Parameters of cmd.invoke. args must match the command's argsSchema.

CmdInvokeResult.description: Result of cmd.invoke: the provider receives a cmd.invoked event with this id, and its answer reaches the caller as cmd.answered.

CmdAnswerRequest.description: Answer one invocation of a command the caller provides: its result, or why it failed.

CmdAnswerParams.description: Parameters of cmd.answer: a result, or an error, not both.

result.description: What the command returns. Any JSON value.

CmdToolsRequest.description: List the commands offered to agents as tools (ADR 0084): what the desk's brain turns offer, and what the desk-tools tool answers.

CmdToolsParams.description: Parameters of cmd.tools. It needs no scope: an agent sees the agent commands its allowlist could let it run, any other caller the ones its cmd:invoke grants cover.

query.description: Words that must each appear, ignoring case, in the command's id, title, description or keywords.

limit.description: How many tools at most; 50 when absent.

CmdToolsResult.description: Result of cmd.tools, in registration order.

CommandTool.description: A command offered to agents as a tool: what it does, the args it takes, what it answers, and whether the caller may run it now.

name.description: The tool's name in a brain turn: the command id with every dot an underscore (endue.git.state is endue_git_state). Absent when the id is longer than 64 characters; desk-run still runs it.

argsSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) of the args; absent means the command takes none.

resultSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) of the answer; absent when it is not described.

irreversible.description: An agent's call waits for the person's approval, every time (ADR 0078).

granted.description: A grant the caller holds covers the command now. An agent's call without one asks the person first.

CmdRecentRequest.description: List the last command invocations the core saw, for an inspector.

CmdRecentResult.description: Result of cmd.recent: the last 200 invocations at most, oldest first.

CommandInvocation.description: One cmd.invoke the core saw: who ran which command, who provided it, when, and once it was answered how long it took and how it ended. One still waiting has no durationMs and no ok.

at.description: When it was invoked, RFC 3339 on the core's clock.

durationMs.description: Milliseconds from cmd.invoke to its answer.

ok.description: Whether it was answered with a result rather than an error.

CommandFailureCode.description: failed: the command ran and failed; cancelled: the person or the provider gave up (a pick dismissed, a provider that stopped).

CmdChangedEvent.description: A command was registered, updated or unregistered. Sent to callers subscribed to cmd.changed.

CmdInvokedEvent.description: A command was invoked. Sent to its provider, which runs it, and to callers subscribed to cmd.invoked.

CmdInvokedData.description: Payload of cmd.invoked: which command, with what, and who asked.

CmdAnsweredEvent.description: A command's provider answered an invocation. Sent to the caller that invoked it.

CmdAnsweredData.description: Payload of cmd.answered: the invocation, who invoked it, and the answer.

result.description: What the command returned, when ok. Any JSON value.

UndoEntry.description: One invocation on the desk's undo stack: what ran, with what, what it answered, who ran it and when, and the command that undoes it.

command.description: The command that ran; fs.write or fs.restore for a write the core kept a version of.

result.description: What it answered. For a write: { version }, the version that keeps the bytes it replaced.

at.description: When the answer arrived (for a write, when it ran). RFC 3339.

inverse.description: The command that undoes it: its `undo`, or fs.restore for a write.

CmdUndoRequest.description: Undo the newest entry of the desk's undo stack, whoever pushed it: run its inverse with { args, result }.

CmdUndoParams.description: Parameters of cmd.undo. The scope must cover the inverse the entry names (fs.restore for a write).

CmdUndoResult.description: Result of cmd.undo: the entry undone, absent when there was none; for a command, the invocation of its inverse, whose answer reaches the caller as cmd.answered. A write is undone before this answers.

CmdRedoRequest.description: Redo the entry cmd.undo undid last: run its command again with its args (a write: put back what the undo replaced).

CmdRedoParams.description: Parameters of cmd.redo. The scope must cover the entry's command (fs.restore for a write).

CmdRedoResult.description: Result of cmd.redo: the entry redone, absent when there was none; for a command, the invocation that runs it again.

CmdUndoneEvent.description: An entry of the desk's undo stack was undone or redone. Sent to the caller that did it and to callers subscribed to cmd.undone.

redo.description: true for cmd.redo, false for cmd.undo.
